definitions.full: H1679. dobe [ דֹּ֫בֶא ] noun [masculine] perhaps rest , but sense very doubtful (? Arabic rest , †amus ; ᵑ7 ᵑ6 ᵐ5 Onk strength , reading perhaps רבאך compare Samaritan רביך , see Di) דָּבְֶאךָ׃ וּכְיָמֶיךָ Deut 33:25 .
